facts.fact: The 13th Rwanda Governance Scorecard (RGB, 22 October 2026) reports satisfaction with Irembo, the government services platform, at 81.80%, down 5.60 points on the previous assessment.
The scorecard cites 2024 Ministry of ICT and Innovation data that only 11% of government services were fully digitised, letting users complete the process online without other channels.
